lede: Tennessee Titans carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#29 in EPA per play), while Cleveland Browns owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#7 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Tennessee Titans +1.5 with a fair total of 37.5 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Tennessee Titans pass offence vs Cleveland Browns pass defence, which sits −0.329 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
